name: sk-loading
description: Animated arc-based loading spinner for indicating ongoing operations or data fetching.

variants.name: 14px
variants.description: Compact spinner for inline or tight spaces

variants.name: 20px
variants.description: Small spinner for button or form contexts

variants.name: 40px
variants.description: Large spinner for full-page or modal loading

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size of the loading spinner in pixels

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional label text shown below the spinner

accessibility.screenReader: Fully compatible; announces loading status via aria-label

styling.responsive: Adjusts label spacing on small screens

usage.description: Use sk-loading to indicate ongoing operations such as data fetching, form submission, or background processing. Choose size based on context.
dos: Always show loading state during async operations
Use 28px or 40px for section or full-page loading
Replace with result content once loading completes
donts: Don't use for progress with determinate completion (use progress bar)
Don't forget to provide aria-label context
Don't overlay on content without clear indication
